root_cause: Portal connector definitions and sample TEST_PASSED records were metadata-only; original Portal V2 Heartbeat evaluated just eight fixed user-editable portal paths. A selected connector field was never evaluated from an actual provider readback.
prevention_rule: Never treat a configured, activated, safe-tested, paused, revoked, stale, future or different-tenant connector as actual KPI evidence. A connector policy must preserve source={type:connector,connectorId,field}; original runner checks active provider consent, exact definition version/field/page, LIVE_INGEST_VERIFIED execution with external provider-readback ID and an independently stored connector-kpi source observation with matching source revision, tenant, metric mapping and valid numeric/measured timestamp. Browser may not use portal KPI field fallback for connector rules. Original tenant receipt review shows proven source count but not falsely-promoted provider certification, email delivery or external action.
regression_contract: Historical shadow canary fixture: valid connector ingestion triggers original Heartbeat for only its tenant and selected field; duplicate revision yields stable idempotency; same-hour new revision renews scan; denied when no source, sample TEST_PASSED, invalid schema, stale, wrong tenant, revoked opt-in, Active state missing, wrong version, false/NaN value; authenticated UI never cross-contaminates tenant state.

evidence.source: Production original connector_definitions, connector_executions and powerhouse_source_observation_v1 had 0 rows; actual vendor provider ingestion was not independently proven
